findings.claim: The synchronized-output timeout paints once without ending mode 2026, so every later write is held for another second until ESU or reset; repeated BSU also fails to extend the original deadline.
findings.evidence: Built @wterm/dom plus committed WASM painted FIRST after 1,000 ms while synchronizedOutput() remained true; SECOND stayed hidden for another second. A BSU at 900 ms still painted at the original ~1,000 ms deadline. The written spec requires premature termination and deadline extension, and xterm.js clears the mode on timeout.
findings.path: Terminal.setPrivateMode(2026) → WasmBridge.synchronizedOutput → WTerm fallback timer → render, with no timeout transition back to inactive

findings.claim: Queued-frame cancellation and destroy-time fallback cancellation, both previously named regression seams, are not protected by tests that fail when the implementation is removed.
findings.evidence: Removing synchronized-write _cancelScheduledRender or destroy-time _cancelSynchronizedOutputFallback independently leaves all 37 committed DOM tests green; a focused queued-RAF evidence test is green at HEAD and red when cancellation is removed.
findings.path: normal write timer → queued RAF → BSU cancellation; synchronized fallback timer → destroy cancellation
